title: Output phase emits a unary block
statement: For all natural numbers $c,C,q$, every Boolean word $x$, every work-head position function $h\colon\{0,\ldots,c\}\to\mathbb Z$, every Boolean output word $o$, and all $j\le C$, starting in state $\mathrm{emit}(j)$ with input-head position $|x|+1$, tape contents determined by $q$, and head positions $h$, the machine reaches after $j+1$ steps state $\mathrm{advance}(0)$ with the same head positions and output $o$ followed by $j$ copies of true.
